title: FloodGuard Claims Manual — Settlement Provisions
content:
Claims manual provisions for settling flood losses under the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy.

## Coverage in time

A flood is covered only when it began on or after the effective date of the coverage in force; damage from a flood that began during the waiting period is denied with the reason "waiting period".

## Deductibles

Building and contents each take their own deductible per occurrence. Additional living expense, increased cost of compliance and loss avoidance take none.

## Settlement basis

Building damage is settled at replacement cost only on a tier whose building settlement is replacement cost, for a primary residence whose building limit is at least the tier's required share of the building replacement cost on file; otherwise it is settled at actual cash value. Contents follow the tier's contents settlement basis.

- A replacement-cost payment is the replacement-cost amount less the deductible applied.
- An actual-cash-value payment is the replacement-cost amount less the depreciation and less the deductible applied.

| Tier building settlement | Primary residence? | Building limit at least the required share of replacement cost? | Building damage settled at |
|---|---|---|---|
| Replacement cost | Yes | Yes | Replacement cost |
| Replacement cost | Yes | No | Actual cash value |
| Replacement cost | No | Either | Actual cash value |
| Actual cash value | Either | Either | Actual cash value |

*Hypothetical example.* A replacement-cost amount of 20,000 USD, depreciation of 4,000 USD and a 2,000 USD deductible give 18,000 USD at replacement cost, or 14,000 USD at actual cash value.

## Below-grade damage

In a basement only washers, dryers, freezers and the food in them, furnaces, water heaters and electrical panels are covered, unless the tier covers basement contents or finished basement walls, floors and ceilings. Covered basement contents are capped at the tier's basement contents limit. Other basement items are denied with the reason "basement exclusion".

## Advance payments

Advance payments of the tier's advance percentage of the adjuster's undisputed building estimate may be paid before the proof of loss.

## Proof of loss

A claim is paid in full only on a signed proof of loss received no later than the proof-of-loss period that starts on the date of loss. The proof-of-loss period is counted in calendar days from the date of loss, and a proof received on the last day is on time. The date of loss on the claim file, for that claim number, starts the count.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, a 60-day period).* Date of loss 10 April: a signed proof received on 9 June (day 60) is on time; one received on 10 June (day 61) is not.

## Payees and voids

Building payments name the mortgagee as co-payee when one is on file. A payment that has already been voided is never voided again.
